# fyre_vm_check_hostname (Data Source)

Checks if a hostname is available for use in the Fyre environment. Hostnames already in DNS will not be available.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hostname` (String) The hostname to check for availability

### Optional

- `fqdn` (String) Fully qualified domain name (only present when hostname is available)
- `owner` (Attributes) Owner details (only present when hostname is in use) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owner))
- `owning_user` (Number) User ID of current owner (only present when hostname is in use)
- `site` (String) Site location (svl or rtp). Defaults to 'svl' or inherits from provider configuration.
- `vm_id` (String) VM ID of the VM using this hostname (only present when hostname is in use)

### Read-Only

- `details` (String) Human-readable message about hostname availability
- `id` (String) The hostname being checked
- `is_available` (Boolean) Convenience boolean indicating if the hostname is available (true) or in use (false)
- `status` (String) Status of the hostname check: 'success' if available, 'warning' if in use

<a id="nestedatt--owner"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owner`

Optional:

- `email` (String) Owner email address
- `id` (Number) Owner user ID
- `username` (String) Owner username
